title: About Quiet Lens Under Compression
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 265 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @liamsLCjourney: Yesterday, I stepped down as CEO of my company. Not because I wanted to, but... and @alisha_hg: some pieces I’m fond of from the Miró and the United States exhibit at the Phillips..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Quiet Lens Under Compression: Quiet lens-under-pressure material macro, fashion/material macro composition archetype with shallow macro camera grammar. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large transparent eyeglass lens rim, bright vertical left window slit, and clear bridge seam and hinge hardware.
